excerpts.3: 1784: The insubordination begins with the Dragon Command and Tiger Command declaring independence towards the end of the war with Lingyuk. The Command tries to force their way into Yanshen but Hubao and Bianfang prove too difficult to break through and the Dragon Command is able to redeploy troops to push the Command out of Yanshen in 1785 after the fall of Linyuk. Additionally the Command is unable to push past the fortifications at Portathi and despite some gains in Ghavanaaj the Tiger Command is able to repel the Command by 1786.
excerpts.5: 1786: Seeing that there is no hope in remaining loyal to the Command, the Elephant Command declares independence. In response, the Great Command makes peace with the Dragon Command, formally renouncing their claim to rule Yanshen and instead decides to focus on the Elephant and Tiger Commands. The Command also begins to conscript many more soldiers from the Wuhyun population in order to bolster their armies. These armies are nowhere near as disciplined as the Ninyu Kikun but would serve vital in the Command’s civil war.

records.description: 命令时间线具名天楼城墙抵挡灵域，1775区域图则支持城周受灵域控制。以4871为城市固定条件，实际省图邻接比较选4877、4904两省进入灵域并在共同退却阶段归还；4870由既有同事件步骤负责，不重复转让。在实际1775前态下，四组空间权重得到同一结果；仍因原件没有城郊确界而保留完整天楼防区的竞争解释。
records.reasoning: 同源稿合并计票，按真实接边长度比较4组权重；中等平滑选城市与周边占领并存，所选年不是城郊转属的确年。
records.geometryNote: 真实PNG接边+地区示意图推演；4871不受占领，4870复用identity；两省均属未定确界的城郊推演。

alternatives.reason: 可另取城郊与城内作为完整防区；四组当前权重一致并不能排除此来源解释。

records.title: 萨米萨利克与丹郡：晚期朝贡协约推演
